title: This Sunday Night – let’s talk.
excerpt: I will be the Skype guest this Sunday, May 15, at Darkwood Brew (http://www.onfaithonline.tv/darkwoodbrew/) 5 pm CST/6 pm EST. Those who watch live and participate via chat will have the opportunity to ask questions. Check out the website for more info. See you at the Brew!”
